WITH telescope_counts AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) as obs_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
total_count AS (
  SELECT CAST(SUM(obs_count) AS FLOAT) as total
  FROM telescope_counts
),
share_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    tc.observstation,
    tc.obs_count,
    CAST(tc.obs_count AS FLOAT) / tc2.total as share
  FROM telescope_counts tc
  CROSS JOIN total_count tc2
),
avg_share_all AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM share_calc
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT 
    sc.obs_count,
    sc.share,
    a.avg_share
  FROM share_calc sc
  CROSS JOIN avg_share_all a
  WHERE sc.share > a.avg_share
)
SELECT 
  SUM(obs_count) as combined_telescopes,
  AVG(share) as average_share,
  AVG(share - avg_share) as avg_excess
FROM above_average
